name: Joiada
overview: Joiada is identified in Scripture as the son and successor of Eliashib in the high priesthood, establishing a clear priestly lineage (Nehemiah 12:10-11). The records highlight Joiada's role among the chief Levites and priests during the reign of Darius the Persian, underscoring his leadership in the post-exilic community (Nehemiah 12:22). Additionally, the family connections of Joiada's descendants, including a son-in-law linked to Sanballat the Horonite, reflect the complex social and religious challenges faced by the priesthood at that time (Nehemiah 13:28).
